ambient_events: Behind the panelling, the suite is a muffled hush; you're further in than anyone is meant to reach.
Warm light pools over cushions and hanging silks, everything arranged for waiting.
A faint, expensive perfume hangs close in the small space.
description: A concealed boudoir folded into the wall behind the owner's suite: no bigger than a large closet, and warmer than anywhere aboard. Layered silks, a heaped daybed, a low lamp that never fully brightens. This is where Roxy and Jolie keep themselves out of sight, waiting on exactly one person; nobody else is supposed to know the room is here. The false panel leads back OUT to the suite.
name: Echelon — Concealed Boudoir
